newsitem.title: UK: Bricom to pay UK five mln stg compensation.
newsitem.headline: Bricom to pay UK five mln stg compensation.

text.p: The Bricom Group is to pay five million stg in compensation to Britain's Ministry of Defence in settlement of a claim for structural damage to Tornado aircraft, defence procurement minister James Arbuthnot said on Tuesday.
Bricom owned Airwork Ltd in 1992-3, when it had a contract to modify 16 Tornado F3s for the Royal Air Force. The company is now a unit of Bombardier Inc.
Arbuthnot said Britain had spent 20 million stg in repairing the aircraft, after ending Airwork's contract, by replacing their centre fuselages with those from surplus Tornado F2s.
But this had had the advantage of giving the F3s "valuable additional fatigue life", he said in a written parliamentary reply.

"Taking this improvement into account, together with the costs which might have been incurred had arbitration been pursued, we have agreed that the Bricom Group...will pay fove million stg to the Ministry of Defence in settlement of the claim," he said.
